text: 截至10月12日，年内A股市场已有21家公司完成摘牌退市，类型覆盖财务型退市、重大违法强制退市、交易型退市、主动退市等多种情形。其中，财务型退市13家、重大违法强制退市4家，两者合计占比超过八成。常态化、多元化的退市机制正在重塑资本市场生态。（证券日报）
text_en: As of October 12, 21 companies in the A-share market have completed delisting this year, covering various types including financial delisting, mandatory delisting for major violations, trading-based delisting, and voluntary delisting. Among them, there were 13 financial delistings and 4 mandatory delistings for major violations, together accounting for more than 80%. A normalized and diversified delisting mechanism is reshaping the capital market ecosystem. (Securities Daily)
